title: InflaRx Announces Participation in September Investor Conferences
body_markdown:
**Jena, Germany, August 20, 2026** – InflaRx N.V. (Nasdaq: IFRX), a biopharmaceutical company pioneering anti-inflammatory therapeutics by targeting the complement system, today announced it will participate in two investor conferences in September 2026. Details are as follows:


**Cantor Global Healthcare Conference 2026**


September 9 - 11, 2026 in New York, NY


Fireside chat on September 9th at 3:20 PM ET


InflaRx will also conduct one-on-one investor meetings on September 9th. A link to view the fireside chat live stream and its replay will become availablehere in the coming days.


**H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference**


September 14 - 16, 2026 in New York, NY


Presentation on September 14th at 10:00 AM ET


InflaRx will also conduct one-on-one investor meetings on September 14th. A link to register for the presentation live stream and its replay is availablehere .


***About InflaRx***


InflaRx (Nasdaq: IFRX) is a biopharmaceutical company pioneering anti-inflammatory therapeutics by applying its proprietary anti-C5a and anti-C5aR technologies to discover, develop and commercialize highly potent and specific inhibitors of the complement activation factor C5a and its receptor, C5aR. C5a is a powerful inflammatory mediator involved in the progression of a wide variety of inflammatory diseases. InflaRx‘s lead program is izicopan, an orally administered small molecule inhibitor of C5a-induced signaling via the C5a receptor, which has shown promising PK/PD characteristics as well as therapeutic potential in Phase 1 and Phase 2a clinical studies. The Company is developing izicopan for the treatment of ANCA-associated vasculitis and additional renal diseases. InflaRx also has developed vilobelimab, a novel, intravenously delivered, first-in-class, anti-C5a monoclonal antibody that selectively binds to free C5a and has demonstrated disease-modifying clinical activity and tolerability in multiple clinical studies.


InflaRx was founded in 2007, and the group has offices and subsidiaries in Jena and Munich, Germany, as well as Ann Arbor, MI, USA. For further information, please visit[www.inflarx.de](https://www.inflarx.de/) . Follow InflaRx on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/inflarx/) . InflaRx GmbH (Germany) and InflaRx Pharmaceuticals Inc. (USA) are wholly owned subsidiaries of InflaRx N.V. (together, InflaRx).
